findings.description: A Content-Type parameter with no '=' (e.g. 'text/html; charset') is now stored as the boolean True, so get_encoding_from_headers calls .strip() on a bool and raises AttributeError.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a response header like 'Content-Type: text/html; charset' (valued-less charset). _parse_content_type_header now sets params['charset'] = True instead of skipping it, so line 544 evaluates True.strip(...). Mechanism: the new default value is a non-string that the caller assumes is a string. Impact: accessing response.encoding or response.text on such a response raises an exception where previously it fell back to a default encoding.
